pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 上 (shàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bedroom
   B. Kitchen
   C. On
   D. Room

2. What does 电视 (diànshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Television
   B. Table
   C. To put
   D. Kitchen

3. How many strokes does 三 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 2
   C. 3
   D. 5

4. Read the pinyin: wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Wednesday.
   B. On Saturday I rest at home.
   C. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   D. On Wednesday I go to school.

5. What does 星期一 (xīngqīyī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Monday
   C. Five
   D. Today

6. What does 杯子 (bēizi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To give (a gift)
   B. We
   C. To wish
   D. Cup

7. Which sentence is written on a birthday card? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 再见!
   C. 你好吗?
   D. 祝你生日快乐!

8. Which sentence is correctly punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. 我吃米饭。你呢?
   B. 我吃米饭!你呢。
   C. 我吃米饭、你呢、
   D. 我吃米饭? 你呢。

9. What does 什么 (shénme) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snacks
   B. What
   C. Meat
   D. Fruit (as a group)

10. Which word is pronounced xǐshǒu? (1 mark)
   A. 肩膀
   B. 头
   C. 洗手
   D. 说

11. Which Chinese word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. 牙 yá
   B. 用 yòng
   C. 摸 mō
   D. 看 kàn

12. What does 听 (tīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. To listen, to hear
   C. To brush teeth
   D. Shoulder

13. Which Chinese word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 tàiyáng
   B. 也 yě
   C. 天气 tiānqì
   D. 小 xiǎo

14. Which sentence means "Today it rains."? (1 mark)
   A. 风很小。
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 今天天气很好。

15. How does too much rain harm the environment? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the sun brighter
   B. It makes the soil drier
   C. It always makes the wind stronger
   D. It can cause floods

16. Read the pinyin: mén zài zuǒbian. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   B. The television is on the table.
   C. The door is on the left.
   D. The sofa is beside the door.

17. What does 房子 (fángzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. House
   B. Bed
   C. Cat
   D. Window

18. How many strokes do 左 and 右 each have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 3
   C. 6
   D. 4

19. What is self-assessment? (1 mark)
   A. Marking a friend
   B. Ignoring your work
   C. Checking your own work and progress
   D. Copying work

20. What does 大家好 dàjiā hǎo mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Happy birthday
   C. Goodbye
   D. Hello, everybody

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

22. Write a short dialogue of four lines in Chinese with pinyin: two friends greet each other and one says it is their birthday. (4 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table." (3 marks)

24. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana." (2 marks)

26. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 肉, 用 and 摸. (3 marks)

27. Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

28. Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps. (4 marks)

29. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ. (2 marks)

30. Write two foods from each group: fruit and meat, with pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — On
   上 (shàng) means on.

2. A — Television
   电视 (diànshì) means television.

3. C — 3
   三 is three horizontal lines.

4. B — On Saturday I rest at home.
   wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi. is 我星期六在家休息。, which means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

5. B — Monday
   星期一 (xīngqīyī) means Monday.

6. D — Cup
   杯子 (bēizi) means cup.

7. D — 祝你生日快乐!
   祝你生日快乐 is happy birthday to you.

8. A — 我吃米饭。你呢?
   A statement ends with 。 and a question with ?.

9. B — What
   什么 (shénme) means what.

10. C — 洗手
   洗手 is pronounced xǐshǒu and means to wash hands.

11. A — 牙 yá
   牙 (yá) means tooth.

12. B — To listen, to hear
   听 (tīng) means to listen, to hear.

13. A — 太阳 tàiyáng
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

14. C — 今天下雨。
   今天下雨。 (jīntiān xià yǔ.) means "Today it rains.".

15. D — It can cause floods
   Heavy rain causes floods.

16. C — The door is on the left.
   mén zài zuǒbian. is 门在左边。, which means "The door is on the left.".

17. A — House
   房子 (fángzi) means house.

18. A — 5
   Both have five strokes.

19. C — Checking your own work and progress
   You look at what you did well and what to improve.

20. D — Hello, everybody
   大家 is everybody.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好! nǐ hǎo! A: 今天是我的生日。 jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. B: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line, with pinyin.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: 肉: ròu, meat. 用: yòng, to use. 摸: mō, to touch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today it rains.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fruit: 芒果 mángguǒ, 香蕉 xiāngjiāo. Meat: 牛肉 niúròu, 鸡肉 jīròu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fruit, 1 mark for meat, 1 mark for correct pinyin.
